1.1: Betza shennolda veyom tov, bet shammay omrim, teachel. uvet hillel omrim, lo teachel. bet shammay omrim, seor bechazzayit vechametz bechakkotevet. uvet hillel omrim, ze vaze bechazzayit:
1.2: Hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, bet shammay omrim, yachpor bedeker vichasse, uvet hillel omrim, lo yishchot, ella im ken haya lo afar muchan mibbeod yom. umodim, sheim shachat, sheyyachpor bedeker vichasse, sheefer kira muchan hu:
1.3: Bet shammay omrim, en molichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach, aval mattehu mechallon lechallon. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, lo yittol, ella im ken nianea mibbeod yom. uvet hillel omrim, omed veomer ze vaze ani notel:
1.4: Zimmen shechorim umatza levanim, levanim umatza shechorim, shenayim umatza shelosha, asurim. shelosha umatza shenayim, muttarim. betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken, asurim. veim en sham ella hem, hare ellu muttarim:
1.5: Bet shammay omrim, en mesallekin et hatterisin beyom tov. uvet hillel mattirin af lehachazir. bet shammay omrim, en notlin et haeli lekatztzev alav basar. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, en notnin et haor lifne haddorsan velo yagbihennu, ella im ken yesh immo chazzayit basar. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, en motziin lo et hakkatan velo et hallulav velo et sefer tora lirshut harabbim. uvet hillel mattirin:
1.6: Bet shammay omrim, en molichin challa umattanot lakkohen beyom tov, ben shehuremu meemesh, ben shehuremu mehayyom. uvet hillel mattirin. amru lahem bet shammay, gezera shava, challa umattanot mattana lakkohen, uteruma mattana lakkohen, keshem sheen molichin et hatteruma, kach en molichin et hammattanot. amru lahem bet hillel, lo, im amartem batteruma, sheeno zakkay baharamatah, tomru vammattanot, shezzakkay baharamatan:
1.7: Bet shammay omrim, tevalin niddochin bemadoch shel etz, vehammelach befach, uveetz happarur. uvet hillel omrim, tevalin niddochin kedarkan bemadoch shel even, vehammelach bemadoch shel etz:
1.8: Habborer kitnit beyom tov, bet shammay omrim, borer ochel veochel. uvet hillel omrim, borer kedarko becheko, bekanon uvetamchuy, aval lo vetavla velo venafa velo vichvara. rabban gamliel omer, af mediach veshole:
1.9: Bet shammay omrim, en meshallechin beyom tov ella manot. uvet hillel omrim, meshallechin behema chayya vaof, ben chayyin ben shechutin. meshallechin yenot shemanim uselatot vekitniyyot, aval lo tevua, verabbi shimon mattir bitvua:
1.10: Meshallechin kelim, ben tefurin ben sheenan tefurin, veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen kilayim, vehen letzorech hammoed, aval lo sandal hamesummar velo minal sheeno tafur. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo minal lavan, mippene shetztzarich umman. ze hakkelal, kol shenneotin bo, beyom tov meshallechin oto:

2.1: Yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat, lo yevashshel adam battechilla miyyom tov lashshabbat, aval mevashshel hu leyom tov, veim hotir, hotir lashshabbat, veose tavshil meerev yom tov vesomech alav lashshabbat. bet shammay omrim, shene tavshilin. uvet hillel omrim, tavshil echad. veshavin bedag uvetza shealav shehen shene tavshilin. achalo o sheavad, lo yevashshel alav battechilla. veim shiyyer mimmennu chol shehu, somech alav lashshabbat:
2.2: Chal lihyot achar hashshabbat, bet shammay omrim, matbilin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat, uvet hillel omrim, kelim millifne hashshabbat, veadam bashshabbat:
2.3: Veshavin shemmashshikin et hammayim bichli even letaharan, aval lo matbilin. umatbilin miggav legav umechavura lachavura:
2.4: Bet shammay omrim, meviin shelamim veen somchin alehen, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim, meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehem:
2.5: Bet shammay omrim, lo yachem adam chammin leraglav, ella im ken reuyin lishtiyya. uvet hillel mattirin. ose adam medura umitchammem kenegdah:
2.6: Shelosha devarim rabban gamliel machamir kedivre vet shammay, en tomnin et hachammin miyyom tov lashshabbat, veen zokfin et hammenora veyom tov, veen ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amar rabban gamliel, mimehen shel bet abba lo hayu ofin pittin geritzin, ella rekikin. amru lo, ma naase levet avicha, shehayu machamirin al atzman umekillin lechol yisrael, lihyot ofin pittin geritzin vechori:
2.7: Af hu amar shelosha devarim lehakel, mechabbedin ben hammittot, umannichin et hammugmar beyom tov, veosin gedi mekullas belele fesachim. vachachamim osrin:
2.8: Shelosha devarim rabbi elazar ben azarya mattir, vachachamim osrin. parato yotza virtzua shebben karneha, umekardin et habbehema veyom tov, veshochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahem. rabbi yehuda omer, en mekardin et habbehema veyom tov, mippene sheose chabbura, aval mekartzefin. vachachamim omrim, en mekardin, af lo mekartzefin:
2.9: Harechayim shel pilpelin temea, mishshum shelosha chelim, mishshum keli kibbul, umishshum keli mattachot, umishshum keli chevara:
2.10: Agala shel katan temea midras venittelet beshabbat, veenah nigreret ella al gabbe chelim. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hakkelim en nigrarin chutz min haagala, mippene shehi choveshet:

3.1: En tzadin dagim min habbevarin beyom tov, veen notnin lifnehem mezonot. aval tzadin chayya vaof min habbevarin, venotnin lifnehem mezonot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol habbevarin shavin. ze hakkelal, kol hamechussar tzida asur, vesheeno mechussar tzida muttar:
3.2: Metzudot chayya vaof vedagim sheasaan meerev yom tov, lo yittol mehen beyom tov, ella im ken yodea shennitztzodu meerev yom tov. umaase venachri echad, shehevi dagim lerabban gamliel, veamar, muttarin hen, ella sheen retzoni lekabbel hemennu:
3.3: Behema mesukkenet lo yishchot, ella im ken yesh shahut bayyom leechol mimmenna kazzayit tzali. rabbi akiva omer, afillu chazzayit chay mibbet tevichatah. shechatah bassade, lo yevienna vemot uvemota. aval mevi veyado evarim evarim:
3.4: Bechor shennafal levor, rabbi yehuda omer, yered mumche veyire, im yesh bo mum, yaale veyishchot. veim lav, lo yishchot. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheen mumo nikkar mibbeod yom, en ze min hammuchan:
3.5: Behema shemmeta, lo yezizenna mimmekomah. umaase veshaalu et rabbi tarfon aleha veal hachalla shennitmea, venichnas levet hammidrash veshaal, veamru lo, lo yezizem mimmekomam:
3.6: En nimnin al habbehema lechattechilla beyom tov, aval nimnin aleha meerev yom tov veshochatin umechallekin benehen. rabbi yehuda omer, shokel adam basar keneged hakkeli o cheneged hakkofitz. vachachamim omrim, en mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar:
3.7: En mashchizin et hassakkin beyom tov, aval massiah al gabbe chavertah. lo yomar adam lattabbach, shekol li vedinar basar. aval shochet umechallekim benehen:
3.8: Omer adam lachavero, malle li cheli ze, aval lo vammidda. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya cheli shel midda, lo yemalennu. maase veabba shaul ben batnit, shehaya memalle middotav meerev yom tov venotnan lallakochot beyom tov. abba shaul omer, af bammoed ose chen, mippene verure hammiddot. vachachamim omrim, af bechol ose chen, mippene mitztzuy hammiddot. holech adam etzel chenvani haragil etzlo, veomer lo, ten li betzim veegozim beminyan, shekken derech baal habbayit lihyot mone betoch beto:

4.1: Hammevi chadde yayin mimmakom lemakom, lo yeviem besal uvekuppa, aval mevi hu al ketefo o lefanav. vechen hammolich et hatteven, lo yafshil et hakkuppa laachorav, aval meviah hu veyado. umatchilin baaremat hatteven, aval lo vaetzim shebbammuktze:
4.2: En notlin etzim min hassukka, ella min hassamuch lah. meviin etzim min hassade min hamechunnas, umin hakkarpef afillu min hamefuzzar. ezehu karpef, kol shessamuch lair, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, kol shennichnasin lo vefotachat, vaafillu vetoch techum shabbat:
4.3: En mevakkein etzim, lo min hakkorot, velo min hakkora shennishbera veyom tov. veen mevakkein lo vekardom velo vimgera velo vemaggal, ella vekofitz. bayit shehu male ferot, satum venifchat, notel mimmekom happechat. rabbi meir omer, af pochet lechattechilla venotel:
4.4: En potchin et hanner, mippene shehu ose cheli. veen osin pechamin beyom tov, veen chotchin et happetila lishnayim. rabbi yehuda omer, chotchah baur lishte nerot:
4.5: En shovrin et hacheres, veen chotchin et hanneyar litzlot bo maliach, veen gorfin tannur vechirayim, aval mechabbeshin, veen makkifin shete chaviyyot lishpot alehen et hakkedera, veen somchin et hakkedera vevakkaat, vechen bedelet, veen manhigin et habbehema vemakkel beyom tov, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mattir:
4.6: Rabbi eliezer omer, notel adam kesam mishshellefanav lachatzotz bo shinnav. umegabbev min hechatzer umadlik, shekkol ma shebbechatzer muchan hu. vachachamim omrim, megabbev mishshellefanav umadlik:
4.7: En motziin et haur lo min haetzim, velo min haavanim, velo min heafar, velo min hammayim, veen melabbenin et harafim litzlot bahen. veod amar rabbi eliezer, omed adam al hammuktze erev shabbat bashsheviit, veomer, mikkan ani ochel lemachar. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyirshom veyomar, mikkan vead kan:

5.1: Mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov, aval lo veshabbat, umechassim perot bechelim mippene haddelef, vechen kadde yayin vechadde shemen. venotnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat:
5.2: Kol shechayyavin alav mishshum shevut, mishshum reshut, mishshum mitzva, beshabbat, chayyavin alav beyom tov. veellu hen mishshum shevut, lo olin bailan, velo rochvin al gabbe vehema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, velo metappechin, velo mesappekin, velo merakkedin. veellu hen mishshum reshut, lo danin, velo mekaddeshin, velo choltzin, velo meyabbemin. veellu hen mishshum mitzva, lo makdishin, velo maarichin, velo macharimin, velo magbihin teruma umaaser. kol ellu beyom tov amru, kal vachomer beshabbat. en ben yom tov leshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad:
5.3: Habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim. hammoser behemto livno o leroe, hare ellu cheragle habbealim. kelim hameyuchadin leachad min haachin shebbabbayit, hare ellu cheraglav. vesheen meyuchadin, hare ellu chimkom sheholchin:
5.4: Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov, keragle hashshoel. beyom tov, keragle hammashil. haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah tevalin umayim umelach leissatah, hare ellu cheragle shetehen. rabbi yehuda foter bemayim, mippene sheen bahen mammash:
5.5: Haggachelet keragle habbealim, veshalhevet bechol makom. gachelet shel hekdesh moalin bah, veshalhevet lo nehenin velo moalin. hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim, chayyav. veshalhevet, patur. bor shel yachid, keragle hayyachid. veshel anshe otah hair, keragle anshe otah hair. veshel ole vavel, keragle hamemalle:
5.6: Mi shehayu ferotav beir acheret, veervu vene otah hair lehavi etzlo mipperotav, lo yaviu lo. veim erav hu, perotav kamohu:
5.7: Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim, lo yolichu veyadam manot, ella im ken zikka lahem manotehem meerev yom tov. en mashkin veshochatin et hammidbariyyot, aval mashkin veshochatin et habbayatot. ellu hen bayatot, hallanot bair. midbariyyot, hallanot baafar:
